title: Emotional Intelligence Test
description: Explore your emotional intelligence pattern with practical, scenario-based questions.
instructions: Answer from recent real behavior, not an ideal version of yourself.
If a statement reminds you of a concrete situation, it is usually more useful.
Use the result for reflection and communication, not as a diagnosis.

scaleQuestions.question: In recent real situations, I can see a clear Self Awareness pattern in how I choose and act.
When pressure rises, I often rely on a Self Awareness strategy instead of switching styles.
People who work with me would probably notice my Self Awareness tendency.
If an environment blocks Self Awareness for too long, my motivation drops.
During collaboration, I often bring Self Awareness into the way I contribute.
Looking back over the last month, Self Awareness describes a repeated behavior pattern for me.

SELF_AWARENESS.title: Self Awareness
SELF_AWARENESS.summary: In this Emotional Intelligence Test, your result is Self Awareness. Your answers cluster around the behaviors, needs, or reactions represented by this pattern.
strengths: You can create leverage in tasks that reward Self Awareness
You tend to build repeatable strategies
You notice the cues that affect your performance
weaknesses: Under pressure, you may overuse one strategy
Opposite perspectives can be easy to miss
The result should guide you rather than limit you
careers: Find the situations that trigger this pattern
Choose tasks that fit the tendency
relationships: Explain your need for Self Awareness clearly while leaving room for other people's pace and style.
growthPlan: Track the pattern for one week
Practice the new move in a low-risk situation
